name: Battery Pack
description: Guidelines for traveling with battery pack in your luggage.

carryOn.reason: Battery packs and external power banks containing lithium-ion cells must be carried in carry-on baggage only.

checkedBag.reason: Battery packs are prohibited in checked baggage due to risk of fire in the cargo hold.

tsa.pageTitle: Can I bring battery pack on a plane?

travelTips: Battery packs and external power banks containing lithium-ion cells must be carried in carry-on baggage only.

faq.question: Is battery pack allowed in carry-on bags?
faq.answer: Battery Pack is allowed in carry-on luggage. Battery packs and external power banks containing lithium-ion cells must be carried in carry-on baggage only.

faq.question: Can you pack battery pack in checked baggage?
faq.answer: No, Battery Pack is not allowed in checked bags. Battery packs are prohibited in checked baggage due to risk of fire in the cargo hold.
